content: Marmot v2 (GitHub README, fetched 2026-10): leaderless distributed SQLite replication on SWIM-style gossip membership; writes via 2PC distributed transactions with configurable consistency (ONE/QUORUM/ALL); per-row LWW on the transaction commit HLC timestamp, ties broken by higher node ID; anti-entropy log pull heals partitions; new nodes or nodes past log retention bootstrap via full snapshot transfer (parallel snapshot downloads, LRU snapshot caching); gRPC single port; embedded SQLite (WAL mode required); MySQL wire protocol listener; admin HTTP endpoints for cluster membership ops; Prometheus metrics; CDC publishing to Kafka/NATS; limitations: all tables replicated, eventually consistent (rows may sync out of order), >100GB not recommended.
